name: @reticlehq/cli-realm
_private_why: NOT published yet, and this flag is the only thing standing between the branch and a one-way door. `pnpm -r publish` selects every workspace package that is not private, so merging this adapter into a release branch is enough to publish it -- and `npm view @reticlehq/cli-realm` is a 404, which makes a first publication a name claimed permanently at a version nobody can take back. The measurement in bench/cli-false-green went AGAINST this adapter: the no-package skill caught 8 of 8 planted defects and this caught 6. Remove this flag when its owner decides it ships, not before.
description: Reticle realm adapter for command-line tools: spawns a process, watches what it does to the filesystem, and reports evidence an adjudicator can reason over. Needs no code inside the subject.

scripts.prepack: node ../../../scripts/prepare-dist.mjs --clean dist && tsc -b --force && node ../../../scripts/alias-dist.mjs && node ../../../scripts/prepare-dist.mjs dist

author: Reticle contributors
